{{Top|leg}}
The '''Republic Treasury Reserve''' was a financial reserve that was operated by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Following the abolition of the [[Aurodium standard/Legends|aurodium standard]], the [[Bank of the Core/Legends|Bank of the Core]] became one of the reserve's key backers.
